face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

policies.summon: Complete fixed named original tokens, shared actual SummonCause and ordinary sequential SummonByCard requests; Overload before accepted native body tuple.
policies.portals: Original damage then attributed ordinary constructed.cards collectible MINION cost1/3 pool request, without executable-coverage filtering.
policies.jade: Distinct original CFM_707/WON_082 faces each deal3 once and use existing complete classic shared Jade family/growth policy; all four existing artwork templates preserved.
policies.corrupt: Actual held original card upgrade through ordinary higher-cost hand play; upgraded face damage then fresh ordinary enemy minion group after the normal checkpoint.
policies.hex: Actual original hexfrog face and public Transform, not silence/destroy/resurrection.

uncertainties: Exact CN overload-notification/quantity and damage-summon checkpoint edges retain existing explicit local policies.
Jade continues its existing classic artwork/growth/full-board-attempt profile; no new universal quantity or lifecycle claim.
